name: Demo AdventureWorks Bikes / Europe XMLA Q1-Q6
label: Demo AdventureWorks Bikes / Europe XMLA Q1-Q6
description: Six-query AdventureWorks demo scenario for O_AW_EUROPE_BIKES_2013_MONTH_REGION_SALES_QUANTITY. It validates useful ALLOW queries for SalesAmount and OrderQuantity, plus out-of-objective, wrong-product, bad-grain and redundant BLOCK cases.

queries.label: AW Q1 — ALLOW SalesAmount by month and region
queries.mdx: SELECT {[Measures].[SalesAmount]} ON COLUMNS, CrossJoin([Date].[Calendar].[Month].Members, [Sales Territory].[Sales Territory].[Sales Territory Region].Members) ON ROWS FROM [Adventure Works DW] WHERE ([Product].[Product Category].[Bikes], [Sales Territory].[Sales Territory Group].[Europe], [Date].[Calendar Year].[2013])

queries.label: AW Q2 — ALLOW OrderQuantity by month and region
queries.mdx: SELECT {[Measures].[OrderQuantity]} ON COLUMNS, CrossJoin([Date].[Calendar].[Month].Members, [Sales Territory].[Sales Territory].[Sales Territory Region].Members) ON ROWS FROM [Adventure Works DW] WHERE ([Product].[Product Category].[Bikes], [Sales Territory].[Sales Territory Group].[Europe], [Date].[Calendar Year].[2013])

queries.label: AW Q3 — BLOCK North America instead of Europe
queries.mdx: SELECT {[Measures].[SalesAmount]} ON COLUMNS, CrossJoin([Date].[Calendar].[Month].Members, [Sales Territory].[Sales Territory].[Sales Territory Region].Members) ON ROWS FROM [Adventure Works DW] WHERE ([Product].[Product Category].[Bikes], [Sales Territory].[Sales Territory Group].[North America], [Date].[Calendar Year].[2013])

queries.label: AW Q4 — BLOCK Accessories instead of Bikes
queries.mdx: SELECT {[Measures].[SalesAmount]} ON COLUMNS, CrossJoin([Date].[Calendar].[Month].Members, [Sales Territory].[Sales Territory].[Sales Territory Region].Members) ON ROWS FROM [Adventure Works DW] WHERE ([Product].[Product Category].[Accessories], [Sales Territory].[Sales Territory Group].[Europe], [Date].[Calendar Year].[2013])

queries.label: AW Q5 — BLOCK Year grain instead of Month/Region grain
queries.mdx: SELECT {[Measures].[SalesAmount]} ON COLUMNS, [Date].[Calendar Year].Members ON ROWS FROM [Adventure Works DW] WHERE ([Product].[Product Category].[Bikes], [Sales Territory].[Sales Territory Group].[Europe], [Date].[Calendar Year].[2013])

queries.label: AW Q6 — BLOCK redundant SalesAmount after Q1
queries.mdx: SELECT {[Measures].[SalesAmount]} ON COLUMNS, CrossJoin([Date].[Calendar].[Month].Members, [Sales Territory].[Sales Territory].[Sales Territory Region].Members) ON ROWS FROM [Adventure Works DW] WHERE ([Product].[Product Category].[Bikes], [Sales Territory].[Sales Territory Group].[Europe], [Date].[Calendar Year].[2013])
